title: Pascal’s Triangle Generator
description: Build Pascal’s triangle up to 20 rows and click any cell to see its binomial coefficient and parents.
howto: Click any cell to see its value, row, column and how it was formed.

faqs.a: Each entry is the binomial coefficient C(n, k) — the number of ways to choose k items from n.

faqs.q: Why does each row sum to a power of 2?
faqs.a: Row n sums to 2^n because it counts all subsets of an n-element set.
Every interior cell is the sum of the two cells directly above it: C(n,k) = C(n−1,k−1) + C(n−1,k).
